Yes — Mira has a confirmed egg allergy (mild hives), noted by Riverdale Pediatrics. Worth flagging clearly to any new caregiver, along with what to watch for and what you'd want them to do if hives show up (wipe/wash contact, let you know right away).

A couple of practical notes for a caregiver handoff:

- Call out egg specifically, including hidden sources (baked goods, some sauces) since reactions have been mild hives so far, not severe.
- Mention her comfort object — the blue elephant — for naps, since that's part of her settling routine.

If you want, I can help you put together a quick one-page caregiver note with this info.
